cohort: The study included 40 women with incisional endometriosis (IE) and 36 age-matched women with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DE), all presenting with histologically typical endometriosis without a known history of malignancy.
finding: Somatic cancer-driver events were detected in 27.5% of incisional endometriosis (IE) cases and 36.1% of deep infiltrating endometriosis (DE) cases, with KRAS activating mutations being more prevalent in DE.
